create_Coordinator: create a Coordinator instance to manage coordinated stop signaling across multiple threads
use_stop_on_exception: use the stop_on_exception context manager to halt all threads when an exception occurs
use_coordinated_get: use coordinated_get to safely retrieve items from a queue while respecting the coordinator stop signal
use_coordinated_put: use coordinated_put to safely add items to a queue while respecting the coordinator stop signal
use_request_stop: call request_stop on the Coordinator to signal all threads to stop their work
